question: How many people travel during the Holi weekend (across all transport modes) in India?
idealClarificationQuestions: Holi weekend = Friday before Holi to Monday after (4 days)? Yes.
Inter-city travel only (excluding daily commute)? Yes.
Train + bus + flight + private car? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian Railways daily passenger trips: ~2.1 crore. Holi weekend 4 days = 8.4 crore base + Holi uplift ~50% = ~13 crore rail trips.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bus (state + private intercity): ~3 crore daily inter-city; 4 days × 1.4 (Holi uplift) = ~17 crore bus trips ≈ 8.5 crore unique.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Private cars (long-distance): ~2 crore family travellers (estimate based on highway toll data).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~17-18 crore Indians make inter-city trips during Holi weekend.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~2.1 crore. Holi weekend 4 days = 8.4 crore base + Holi uplift ~50% = ~13 crore rail trips.
~50% are roundtrip = ~6.5 crore unique inter-city rail travellers.
~3 crore daily inter-city; 4 days × 1.4 (Holi uplift) = ~17 crore bus trips ≈ 8.5 crore unique.
5 lakh daily passengers × 4 days × 1.3 = ~26 lakh flights ≈ ~13 lakh unique.
~2 crore family travellers (estimate based on highway toll data).
~17-18 crore Indians make inter-city trips during Holi weekend.

calculationFlow: Indian Railways daily passenger trips: ~2.1 crore. Holi weekend 4 days = 8.4 crore base + Holi uplift ~50% = ~13 crore rail trips.
But unique travellers (not trips): ~50% are roundtrip = ~6.5 crore unique inter-city rail travellers.
Bus (state + private intercity): ~3 crore daily inter-city; 4 days × 1.4 (Holi uplift) = ~17 crore bus trips ≈ 8.5 crore unique.
Domestic flights: 5 lakh daily passengers × 4 days × 1.3 = ~26 lakh flights ≈ ~13 lakh unique.
Private cars (long-distance): ~2 crore family travellers (estimate based on highway toll data).
Total unique inter-city Holi travellers: 6.5 + 8.5 + 0.13 + 2 = ~17 crore.
Round: ~17-18 crore Indians make inter-city trips during Holi weekend.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~17-18 crore Indians make inter-city trips during Holi weekend.
